verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers 'Creating custom rules' for transaction categorization and describes automation like 'described once, done automatically, reviewed by you' (puzzle-docs-6, puzzle-docs-17), plus high auto-categorization rates (puzzle-docs-18). This supports basic rule-based, event-triggered automation but is scoped narrowly to categorization/bookkeeping tasks rather than a general-purpose rules engine for arbitrary actions on events. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule conditions/action types beyond categorization, evidence of broader trigger-action automation (e.g., custom workflows outside transaction categorization), and independent hands-on corroboration.
